observed_behavior: One working Codex session appeared three times in workingSessions after its worktree had served two released assignments and one current assignment.
expected_behavior: The association history retains all three assignments, while the live working-session view identifies the one session and its current assignment once.
causal_mechanism: The activity subsets filtered the assignment history directly, inheriting its many-to-one relationship to host sessions.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A session-level projection was derived from assignment-level rows without selecting the current association per session.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Every historical assignment repeats the same live host state, inflating session counts and associating current activity with completed plans.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Each live session appears at most once in activity subsets, preferring its non-released assignment while preserving the complete assignment history separately.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Select one current assignment for each session before projecting working, waiting, finished, and idle activity subsets.

applicability_conditions: A retained session is reused for multiple campaign assignments.
known_non_matches: Concurrent distinct sessions each owning one assignment are correctly represented by the prior projection.
confirmation_evidence: The GWEN observation listed one native working session but three workingSessions rows with the same session ID; a focused regression failed with three rows before the correction and passed afterward.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: one working campaign session leaves independent ready plans dispatchable
